verdict.rationale: Graphite ships an official `gt` CLI installable via npm or Homebrew that works on any git repo, plus a GT MCP server that lets AI agents create stacked PRs. Its AI reviews also run automatically on every new PR, so parts of it are scriptable and automation-friendly. However, nothing documents running the CLI headlessly in CI, and `gt config` is described as an interactive menu. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive/CI usage of the CLI, token-based headless auth, CI integration examples or a public API, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
